beats.text: In January 1921, a five masted schooner sailed past a lightship off North Carolina. A stranger did the talking.
A tall, thin man with reddish hair and a foreign accent called through a megaphone. The ship had lost her anchors in a storm, he said.
The keeper noticed something else. The crew were milling around the quarterdeck, where ordinary sailors were kept away.
And the captain was sixty six. Nobody ever described him as tall, red haired, or foreign.
Days later, the same ship was found aground on Diamond Shoals. Every sail set. No one aboard.
The man at the megaphone was never identified. Who do you think he was?
